description: Volassom is a calcium hydroxyapatite (CaHA) collagen-stimulating injectable developed by Korean regenerative-medicine company CGBIO. CaHA microspheres suspended in a carrier gel provide immediate structural support while prompting the patient's own type-I collagen over subsequent months. Note: independent sources verify Volassom as a CaHA biostimulator rather than a PLLA/PDLLA product.
howItWorks: CaHA microspheres (approx. 25-45 um) act as a three-dimensional scaffold in the deep dermis and subdermis. As the carboxymethylcellulose carrier gel resorbs, the microspheres trigger a controlled fibroblast response that lays down new type-I collagen; the calcium-phosphate particles are gradually metabolised while the newly formed collagen matrix persists, giving a combined immediate-and-progressive effect.
composition: Calcium hydroxyapatite (CaHA) microspheres (~30%) suspended in a carboxymethylcellulose carrier gel (~70%); microsphere size ~25-45 um. Supplied approximately 0.8 mL per syringe. Contains no PLLA or PDLLA.
usageNotes: Inject into the deep dermis or subcutis; no reconstitution required as it is supplied as a pre-filled gel. Mould/massage after placement per technique. Delivers an immediate gel-volume effect plus progressive collagen build-up over roughly 2-3 months; space repeat sessions according to clinical response.
features: CaHA microsphere biostimulation with a smooth carrier gel
Dual action: immediate structural support plus progressive collagen stimulation
Pre-filled, ready-to-use format with no reconstitution
Developed by CGBIO, a Korean company with long-standing apatite expertise
benefits: Single product addressing both volume and skin-quality goals
Pre-filled presentation reduces preparation and chair time
Progressive, natural-looking neocollagenesis supports patient retention
Korean-manufactured supply for clinic and distributor sourcing
indications: Skin laxity and loss of firmness
Overall skin-quality decline and collagen loss

description: Gouri is a fully liquid polycaprolactone (PCL) collagen-stimulating injectable from Korean manufacturer DEXLEVO, built on its patented particle-free technology. Unlike microsphere PCL products, Gouri is a homogeneous liquid that spreads through the subdermal plane to stimulate diffuse collagen regeneration rather than adding discrete volume. It is positioned as a global skin-quality and firmness treatment.
howItWorks: The liquid PCL disperses through the subdermal plane and forms a fibroblast-supporting environment. As the biodegradable polymer is slowly metabolised, it drives ongoing neocollagenesis that improves skin firmness and elasticity broadly, giving a natural rejuvenation rather than a localised volumising effect.
composition: Liquid polycaprolactone (PCL), approximately 21%, in a particle-free formulation with no microspheres. Supplied as 1 x 1 mL pre-filled syringe.
usageNotes: Administered through a small number of injection points per side (commonly around five per side) in the subdermal plane, typically after topical anaesthesia. Collagen-driven results build over weeks; a short course of sessions is used for cumulative firmness and longevity.
features: Fully liquid PCL formulation with no microspheres
Small number of injection points per treatment
benefits: Fewer injection points streamline the treatment workflow
Non-volumising rejuvenation broadens the candidate pool
Branded, differentiated technology supports premium positioning
Korean-manufactured supply for clinic sourcing
indications: Skin laxity and loss of firmness
Global facial rejuvenation and skin quality

description: Plavann Lite is a Korean hybrid collagen booster combining poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) microparticles with non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid. The HA delivers immediate hydration and light plumping while the PLLA drives sustained collagen stimulation. The Lite presentation targets fine lines and overall skin quality in the superficial-to-mid dermis.
howItWorks: PLLA microparticles act as a scaffold that prompts fibroblasts to synthesise new type-I collagen over weeks to months, while the co-formulated non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid provides early hydration and a bridging plumping effect until neocollagenesis matures. The lactic-acid material resorbs while the newly built collagen remains.
composition: PLLA (poly-L-lactide) approximately 42.5 mg plus hyaluronic acid approximately 7.5 mg per 50 mg vial; particle size approximately 30-50 um. Supplied as lyophilised powder for reconstitution.
usageNotes: Reconstitute the lyophilised vial and allow hydration per protocol before injecting into the dermis or subdermis. Collagen-driven improvement builds over roughly 6-12 weeks; space repeat sessions across several weeks for cumulative results.
features: Hybrid PLLA plus non-crosslinked HA formulation
Immediate hydration combined with progressive collagen stimulation
Low-payload Lite format tuned for skin quality and fine lines
benefits: Covers both early plumping and long-term collagen goals in one product
Suited to skin-quality and fine-line indications for a broad patient base
Natural, progressive results support patient satisfaction and retention
Korean-sourced hybrid biostimulator for clinic distribution

description: Plavann Volume is the higher-payload presentation of the Korean Plavann hybrid collagen booster, combining poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) microparticles with hyaluronic acid. It is formulated for deeper replenishment and more substantial collagen stimulation than the Lite version. The HA provides an early filling effect while PLLA drives sustained neocollagenesis.
howItWorks: PLLA microparticles form a scaffold that stimulates fibroblasts to produce new type-I collagen over weeks to months, while the co-formulated hyaluronic acid supplies an immediate volumising and hydration effect. The lactic-acid material gradually resorbs while the collagen it induces persists for longer-term correction.
composition: PLLA (poly-L-lactide) approximately 170 mg plus hyaluronic acid approximately 30 mg per 200 mg vial; particle size approximately 30-50 um. Supplied as lyophilised powder for reconstitution.
usageNotes: Reconstitute the lyophilised vial and allow hydration per protocol, then inject into the deep dermis or subcutis for replenishment. Collagen-driven results build over roughly 6-12 weeks; space repeat sessions across several weeks for cumulative volume and firmness.
features: High-payload hybrid PLLA plus HA formulation
Immediate replenishment combined with progressive collagen stimulation
benefits: Addresses deeper volume loss alongside long-term collagen rebuilding
Higher payload supports fuller correction per session
Natural, progressive outcomes aid patient retention
Korean-sourced hybrid biostimulator for clinic distribution
indications: Facial volume loss and deeper replenishment
Skin laxity and loss of firmness
Collagen loss and overall facial rejuvenation

description: Juvelook is a PDLLA plus hyaluronic acid hybrid skin booster from Korean manufacturer VAIM, approved by Korea's MFDS and CE-marked. It pairs poly-D,L-lactic acid microparticles with non-crosslinked HA to combine immediate hydration with progressive collagen stimulation. It is positioned for skin-quality, texture and fine-line rejuvenation rather than discrete volumisation.
howItWorks: PDLLA porous microparticles sit in the dermis and act as a scaffold, stimulating fibroblasts to generate new collagen and elastin over the weeks following treatment. The co-formulated non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid provides immediate hydration and a light plumping effect while the collagen response develops; the PDLLA gradually resorbs while the new collagen persists.
composition: PDLLA (poly-D,L-lactic acid) approximately 42.4 mg plus non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid approximately 7.5 mg per lyophilised vial.
usageNotes: Supplied as lyophilised powder requiring reconstitution and hydration per the treating physician's technique before injection into the superficial-to-mid dermis. Immediate hydration is followed by collagen-driven improvement that builds over the following weeks; space repeat sessions for cumulative skin-quality gains.
features: Hybrid PDLLA plus non-crosslinked HA formulation
Immediate hydration combined with progressive collagen and elastin stimulation
benefits: Combines early radiance with long-term collagen remodelling in one product
Well-suited to skin-quality and fine-line indications for a broad patient base
Recognised regulatory clearances support clinic confidence and marketing
Established Korean manufacturer with wide international distribution
indications: Superficial dermal rejuvenation and skin quality
Overall facial rejuvenation and collagen loss

description: Etrebelle is a poly-D,L-lactic acid (PDLLA) collagen-stimulating injectable from Korean manufacturer Yooyoung Pharmaceutical, offered in 50 mg and 200 mg presentations. PDLLA microparticles act as a scaffold for gradual neocollagenesis, and certain presentations combine PDLLA with hyaluronic acid to add an immediate component. It is intended for professional use in dermal-to-subcutaneous collagen restoration.
howItWorks: Once injected, Etrebelle's PDLLA microparticles act as a scaffold that stimulates fibroblasts to produce new collagen fibres over weeks to months. The PDLLA is naturally degraded by the body over time, leaving behind newly formed collagen for sustained results; where hyaluronic acid is co-formulated it contributes an early plumping effect.
composition: Poly-D,L-lactic acid (PDLLA) microparticles supplied as lyophilised powder for reconstitution. Available in 50 mg and 200 mg presentations; the 200 mg presentation is reported by distributors to combine approximately 170 mg of poly-lactic acid with approximately 30 mg hyaluronic acid.
usageNotes: Reconstitute the lyophilised vial (distributors report reconstitution to roughly 5 mL sterile water) and allow hydration per protocol. Inject into the deep dermis to subcutaneous layer for professional use only. Collagen-driven results build over weeks to months; space repeat sessions per clinical response.
features: Available in 50 mg and 200 mg presentations
Optional hyaluronic acid component for an immediate effect
benefits: Two payload options let clinics match indication to session goals
Progressive collagen rebuilding delivers natural, durable outcomes
Professional-use format suited to experienced injectors
Korean-manufactured biostimulator for clinic sourcing

description: aesPlla is a pure poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) collagen stimulator from Korean company Oreon Life Science, supplied as a 365 mg lyophilised powder. It contains no immediate-fill component, instead driving gradual collagen regeneration for natural, progressive correction. It is CE-marked and positioned for practitioners seeking a high-payload PLLA biostimulator.
howItWorks: Reconstituted PLLA microparticles are placed in the deep dermis and hypodermis where they act as a biodegradable scaffold, prompting fibroblasts to produce new type-I collagen over the following weeks and months. The PLLA polymer is gradually resorbed while the newly formed collagen provides progressive volumisation and smoothing.
composition: Poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) 365 mg per vial as lyophilised powder; no hyaluronic acid. Reconstituted with approximately 5 mL sterile water.
usageNotes: Reconstitute with approximately 5 mL sterile water (18G needle) and allow the suspension to hydrate; use within about 72 hours of preparation. Inject via linear-threading into the deep dermis and hypodermis using a cannula or needle. Results typically emerge from around 4 weeks and continue to build over subsequent months; space sessions per protocol, with reported longevity up to about 3 years.
features: Pure PLLA formulation with no HA fill component
Suited to linear-threading deep dermal and hypodermal placement
benefits: High payload supports broad-area collagen rebuilding per vial
Gradual, natural correction differentiates from immediate-fill products
Long reported duration supports patient value proposition
Established Korean manufacturer for clinic and distributor sourcing
indications: Volume deficiency in temples, cheeks and marionette lines

description: AestheFill is a poly-D,L-lactic acid (PDLLA) microsphere collagen stimulator from Korean manufacturer REGEN Biotech. Its sponge-like porous microspheres allow new collagen to form both around and within each particle, driving progressive, natural rejuvenation. The powder requires only a short reconstitution and comparatively little water relative to older PLLA products.
howItWorks: The porous PDLLA microspheres are injected into the dermal or subdermal layers where they act as a scaffold, triggering a controlled fibroblast response. New type-I collagen grows around and inside each sponge-like particle over several months; the PDLLA is biocompatible and biodegradable and resorbs over time while the induced collagen persists for durable correction.
composition: Poly-D,L-lactic acid (PDLLA) porous microspheres supplied as lyophilised powder for reconstitution. (Per-vial milligram content is not stated on the manufacturer page.)
usageNotes: Reconstitute the lyophilised powder, which REGEN Biotech notes requires only a short reconstitution time and little water; hydrate per protocol before injecting into the deep dermis or subdermis. Gradual results begin around 4-6 weeks with peak effect at roughly 3-6 months and reported longevity of about 18-24 months; space repeat sessions per clinical response.
features: Collagen forms both around and inside each particle
Short reconstitution time with little water required
benefits: Faster, simpler reconstitution than older PLLA products streamlines preparation
Progressive, natural-looking neocollagenesis supports patient satisfaction
Long reported duration strengthens the treatment value proposition
Established Korean manufacturer with international distribution
indications: Deep wrinkles and folds, including nasolabial folds
